notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Diaochan.
Diaochan does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Diaochan by tapping it, destroying an opponent's creature and any creature of that opponent's choice.
If the opponent chooses a creature you control to be destroyed, it is not destroyed due to it having indestructible.
The creature the opponent controls dies, triggering Diaochan, untapping Diaochan.
Repeat.
